name: Bloodmail 3-piece procs on damaging melee abilities (#12204)
contract: #12204: Bloodmail 3-piece (proc dummies 823732) never procced. Every dummy carries Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and
the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it. Tooltip: "Damaging melee abilities
have a chance". The Valor 3-piece (823738) has the same wording and its merged row uses flags 16 (melee
abilities, no auto attacks); the same row is used. spell_proc_chance reads each loaded entry's chance, which
equals the record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown. aura_proc_rate
replays the aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic event per check.
It procs on a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78), at the record's chance; it never procs on a landed
melee auto attack, a landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116). Before the repair the chance and cooldown
lookups fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
DISCRIMINATING: a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78) procs 823732 at 25%
CONTROL: a landed melee auto attack procs 823732 at 0%
CONTROL: a landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116) procs 823732 at 0%
